note: Coordinator judgments made after #152's rulings froze, joining each attempt's own stage records (candidate ledgers, discovery-barrier freeze, admitted finder claims, verifier dispatches) to the register's defect IDs. Stage evidence is operational, not ground truth; every row cites the sealed evidence it reads. 'admissible' is the screen's view after operational validity is joined: an attempt that is invalid, or unresolved, or stopped is not a valid completed outcome, so its recovery is measured but not admissible.

stage_vocabulary.never-discovered: no candidate raised by the primary, a finder or a verifier names the defect or a manifestation of it
stage_vocabulary.raised-then-rejected-by-primary: a candidate naming it was raised (by the primary or admitted from the finder) and dropped in primary falsification, including acquitted as intentional
stage_vocabulary.omitted-from-verification-by-policy: the pinned policy dispatched no verifier for the row or the clean verdict, so no fresh context attacked it
stage_vocabulary.verifier-refuted-or-unresolved: a verifier received the candidate and refuted it or left it unresolved
stage_vocabulary.publication-or-cap-loss: the finding was admitted and verified but lost to the item cap, the whole-review budget or a stop before publication
stage_vocabulary.unknown: the retained traces do not establish the stage

origin_vocabulary.primary: raised by the primary reviewer before any finder claim was admitted
origin_vocabulary.finder: raised by arm C's bounded discovery worker and admitted at the barrier
origin_vocabulary.verifier-added: added by the verifier as a correction or second scenario on a candidate it received
